note: GAM-010 The Cipher — corpus of primary-document sentences to encipher. STARTER SET = neutral, public-domain, intelligible-standalone, non-inflammatory sentences from real cited documents (per AC editorial filter). Ongoing corpus + binding each quote to the live Claridas article that cited it (articleUrl) is EDITORIAL (Onett). Each entry: text (90-140 chars, letters + spaces + basic punctuation), source, date, optional articleUrl.

quotes.text: All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights, endowed with reason and conscience.
quotes.source: Universal Declaration of Human Rights, Article 1

quotes.text: Everyone has the right to a standard of living adequate for the health and well-being of himself and his family.
quotes.source: Universal Declaration of Human Rights, Article 25

quotes.text: The right of peaceful assembly shall be recognized, and no restrictions may be placed on its exercise without law.
quotes.source: International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, Article 21

quotes.text: Education shall be directed to the full development of the human personality and to the strengthening of respect for rights.
quotes.source: Universal Declaration of Human Rights, Article 26

quotes.text: All peoples have the right of self-determination, and by that right they freely determine their political status.
quotes.source: International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights, Article 1
